selection_rule: For each family, consider its existing desktop control and every completed new candidate. Find the highest selected-checkpoint validation macro-F1. Among candidates within 0.001 inclusive of that maximum, prefer fewer parameters, then higher validation macro-F1, then source path and candidate ID. A wider candidate must therefore exceed a smaller control by more than 0.001 to displace it. Checkpoints follow configured early_stopping_min_delta=0.0001. No test score or test prediction enters selection. This practical tolerance does not establish statistical significance.
